model.name: Wilkinson divider (2.4 GHz)
model.description: Equal-split microstrip Wilkinson divider on a RO4003C-like substrate: two 70.7 ohm quarter-wave arms, 100 ohm isolation resistor, three 50 ohm lumped ports.
model.reference: E. J. Wilkinson, IRE Trans. MTT 8(1), 1960; D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., sec. 7.3
